mechanism_narrative: Persistently lower WORKPLACES mobility signals fewer weekday trip chains through commercial corridors, so retail and recreation spending remains suppressed and RETAIL_REC falls further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior four-week mean even though WORKPLACES stays at or below its current level for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated while TRANSIT remains deeply depressed, people concentrate activities near home and shift away from discretionary shopping districts, pushing RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -75 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -75 and RESIDENTIAL remaining above 25.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-over-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM indicates tighter avoidance of nonessential trips and broader caution, which spills over into discretionary retail visits and lowers RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM continues to decline week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility stabilizes or rebounds while WORKPLACES stays deeply negative, weekend recreation substitutes for retail outings and RETAIL_REC will remain weak over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises after a prior two-week decline while WORKPLACES stays below -70
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall or remains flat over the next 14 days despite PARKS rebounding and WORKPLACES staying below -70.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increases in RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with continued losses in TRANSIT imply substitution toward stay-at-home routines, which reduces discretionary retail trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its prior four-week average over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and TRANSIT remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT approaches an extreme low and then stops falling, the retail decline can bottom out quickly because essential local shopping becomes the remaining trip type; in that case RETAIL_REC should improve within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses below -80 and then stops declining for at least one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to fall over the next 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -80 and flattens.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM suggests a shift toward local, lower-distance activity patterns that can precede short retail stabilization; RETAIL_REC should stop deteriorating within two weeks if both series rebound together.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both increase for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC keeps declining for the next 14 days even though PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both rise for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued collapse in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates that commuting and office-linked shopping remain absent, so discretionary retail traffic keeps eroding and RETAIL_REC falls further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain near or below their current depressed levels.
